lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Streetlights bleeding through the heavy haze
Tracing shadows in a rhythmic maze
Walking slow on the cracked sidewalk stone
Finding a spark in the quiet unknown
[Pre-Chorus]
The clock is ticking on the wall
Waiting for the rain to fall
[Chorus]
Hold the line through the rising tide
Nowhere left for the soul to hide
Heavy heart beating like a steady drum
Waiting for the morning light to come
[Verse]
Coffee's cooling in a chipped blue cup
Watching the city slowly waking up
Shadows stretch long across the floor
Searching for the key to every door
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind whispers secrets in my ear
Chasing away every lingering fear
[Chorus]
Hold the line through the rising tide
Nowhere left for the soul to hide
Heavy heart beating like a steady drum
Waiting for the morning light to come
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
A spark of fire in the pouring rain
Washing away the dust and the pain
[Chorus]
Hold the line through the rising tide
Nowhere left for the soul to hide
Heavy heart beating like a steady drum
Waiting for the morning light to come
[Outro]
